protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In affected SSH2 packet processing, the received MAC is removed from the packet and compared with a locally computed equal-length MAC using PHP !=. That comparison is variable-time; both UMAC and other non-AEAD HMAC paths disconnect and throw on mismatch. The fixed code uses hash_equals (or the 1.x/2.x constant-time _equals wrapper). CVE-2026-40194 is currently PUBLISHED with CWE-208 and the stated affected ranges.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed df0fe2386a66e8b9625d254df5488bdf8f172149. It adds phpseclib/Net/SSH2.php and first-writes the vulnerable comparison at line 1058. git log -L through 1.0.27 and 3.0.50 traces the surviving sink back to this commit; later sequence-number, hash-method, exception, and UMAC changes retain the same != mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The sole immediate parent is 367ddebf805eb0071eb4b9deb3abf7e16866c040; its tree has only phpseclib/Net/SSH1.php under phpseclib/Net and no SSH2.php, so the vulnerable sink is absent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed not applicable. The BIC is a single-parent public git-svn revision (trunk@4), not a merge or squash. Although it adds multiple changes, the SSH2.php addition is directly inspectable and no finer public member is reconstructable.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed. The BIC is an ancestor of 0.1.1, 1.0.27, 2.0.52, and 3.0.50; the latter three tag trees visibly retain the variable-time comparison. CVE-2026-40194 lists affected ranges >=0.1.1 <1.0.28, >=2.0.0 <2.0.53, and >=3.0.0 <3.0.51.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed. ffe48b6b1b1af6963327f0a5330e3aa004a194ac is an ancestor of 1.0.28 and, through merges 3c7de67772a915df14140348baa899c5bbfdd24a and 254140b34b8d738c53686f0362b22e2153d893ea, of 2.0.53 and 3.0.51. It is not an ancestor of 1.0.27, 2.0.52, or 3.0.50; fixed tag trees show constant-time comparison.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix ffe48b6b1b1af6963327f0a5330e3aa004a194ac. Its diff replaces the 1.x != comparison with !_equals and implements constant-time equality; that repair is then merged forward into the fixed 2.x and 3.x releases.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed NOT_AI from the BIC only. Commit df0fe2386a66e8b9625d254df5488bdf8f172149 was authored and committed by Jim Wigginton <terrafrost@php.net> in 2007, carries only a git-svn-id trailer, and has no AI, bot, generated-with, or co-author marker. No later fix metadata was used for attribution.

findings: Independent clone and advisory replay confirms the primary vulnerability lifecycle, BIC, parent absence, release gates, direct fix chain, and NOT_AI attribution without a field correction.
